messages:
incident-bot: PAGING — auth-proxy log router: unexpected header mirror to logs-mirror detected. spike started 2026-03-17T13:02:00Z, ~4k requests over 2m. potential user-identifying metadata in mirrored payloads. severity: P2.
alice: oncall alice here, taking initial triage. where is the mirror target? link to alert?
incident-bot: logs-mirror.endpoint = logs-mirror.internal.redwood:9200, flow id = fm-9c2b. sample entries show header `X-SSO-USERMETA` forwarded.
bob: sec-sre bob — acknowledged. quick ask: is this staging-only or crossed to prod? any customer-facing ingress?
cs-rep: cs-rep — alerted: one internal staging customer reported seeing unhashed user metadata in their staging logs earlier today. no prod reports yet.
alice: ok. immediate containment steps: 1) block outbound to logs-mirror 2) rotate staging logging key 3) scrub mirror index 4) notify legal if customer PII confirmed. executing now.
dave: deploying ipblock via network ACLs to prevent further egress to logs-mirror.
carol: carol (infra) — applying temporary deny to service tag auth-proxy in VPC. command:

```
aws ec2 create-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0abc --rule-number 200 --protocol -1 --cidr-block 10.11.12.34/32 --egress true --rule-action deny
```
carol: applied. egress to 10.11.12.34 (logs-mirror) now blocked from our VPC.
bob: sec-sre running fast grep on log mirror index to quantify exposure. sample query:

```
GET /mirror-index-*/_search
{ "query": { "match": { "headers.X-SSO-USERMETA": "*" } }, "size": 50 }
```
bob: initial count ~1,760 documents with header populated; timestamps 12:58–13:04 UTC. looks staging-only but need verification.
alice: good. next: rotate the KMS key used by staging log-forwarder. carol, can you trigger key rotation and update forwarder creds?
carol: rotating now. creating new key alias alias/staging-logs-key-v2 and re-encrypting current envelope keys. steps:

```
# create new CMK
aws kms create-key --description "staging logs forwarder v2"
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/staging-logs-key-v2 --target-key-id <new-key-id>
# update forwarder config secret
kubectl -n infra set secret generic forwarder-creds --from-literal=kms_alias=alias/staging-logs-key-v2
```
carol: new key in place. forwarder restarted and confirmed NOT reaching logs-mirror (blocked). encryption rotated for new batches.
bob: running scrub job to delete exposed documents from mirror index and replace with redacted versions. will snapshot index before mutation.
alice: legal — what's the threshold to escalate to incident/legal notification and customer outreach?
legal: legal here. if any identifiable personal data left in mirror index OR customer data appears, escalate. preserve snapshots and all logs for chain-of-custody. do not purge anything until we snapshot.
bob: snapshot done: s3://redwood-incidents/5712345678/snapshot-20260317.tar.gz
bob: starting scrub job now — redaction rule: remove X-SSO-USERMETA and replace with <REDACTED-SSO>. will run on copies.
carol: initiating forwarder config rollback to safe path: disable mirror rule in logrouter config:

```
# disable mirror rule
PATCH /v1/config/logrouter
{ "mirror": { "enabled": false, "targets": [] } }
```
carol: mirror disabled. no further duplication to logs-mirror even if network unblock.
alice: customer impact assessment — cs-rep, confirm affected environments and customers.
cs-rep: only staging org `acme-inc-staging` reported seeing metadata. they say some test users' emails appeared in staging index. no production customers impacted per monitoring.
bob: risk: internal staging customer PII exposure. plan: 1) preserve snapshot, 2) scrub mirror index copies, 3) rotate keys, 4) notify acme staging contact with containment summary, 5) run audit to ensure no prod exposure.
alice: timeline notes for incident ticket: started 13:02 UTC, containment block applied 13:05, mirror disabled 13:08, rotation complete 13:12, scrub in progress.
legal: prepare draft notification for acme staging; include what we know, remediation steps, and offer support. loop in trust@redwood.
carol: scrub job completed for index mirror-index-2026-03-17. replaced sensitive fields with <REDACTED-SSO>. archived original snapshot to secure bucket (access: sec-sre, legal, s3-admin only).
bob: running post-check: requery mirror replica — 0 matches for headers.X-SSO-USERMETA. rotation verified; forwarder logs show no further mirror attempts.
alice: ok handoff: i'm handing incident to carol for monitoring and CS follow-through for the next 6 hours. notes in incident tracker IT-5712345678.
carol: ack. will monitor ingestion metrics and auth-proxy egress flows. will escalate if any anomalous retries or if scrub reports fail.
alice: one more action: rotate any ephemeral API keys used by the forwarder service in staging. carol/dave to confirm.
dave: rotated forwarder API key and invalidated old tokens in vault. updated deploys.
cs-rep: customer outreach draft sent to acme staging contact; waiting for legal approval. no immediate customer-facing outage.
legal: draft approved. send when scrub verification complete. include timeline and steps to avoid future occurrence.
bob: follow-up tasks created: (1) add automated header redaction rule in logrouter (2) add test to CI to prevent mirror rules from applying to headers with sensitive keys (3) postmortem to eng and security teams.
alice: thanks team — incident remains P2 due to data exposure potential. handing off done. :white_check_mark:
carol: closing channel in 2h if no regressions. acked by: carol, bob, dave.
